label: nyiso 146c state scoped
definition: KEEPER (promoted nyiso-146, 2026-08-19): the ONLINE-HOURS LSL STATE FLOOR, duty-scoped by the measured run-length gap. Two fields over the superseded keeper 2026-08-18-nyiso-144-layup-exclusion (single-delta at each registered link): nyiso_gas_bridge_online_hours (the ercot141 floor_online_hours detector leg, gas_cc-scoped — a synchronized CC's LSL block is must-take in EVERY P0-online hour) and nyiso_gas_bridge_state_floor_min_run (the floor holds ONLY plants whose measured plant-basis run-length p25 clears the 6.6x population gap: {2539 Bethlehem, 56234 Caithness, 56196 Poletti} at 130-646 h vs the 7-20 h cyclers). Repairs the nyiso-145 CC over-cycling object: Bethlehem 327/526/262 P1 starts (metered 6-7/yr) -> 41/10/15 with median runs 12/7/14 h -> 68/144/319 h; Caithness -> 3/2/4 vs 4/6/8 metered. Zero new fitted scalars; zero new D-4/D-1 findings; criterion statuses identical to control; as promoted it scored every gated criterion PASS with C3c the lone ledgered caveat (bit-identical 2/0/5 h). || DETERMINATION RESTATED 2026-08-21 (nyiso-148, OWNER RULING): NOT-YET. Nothing about this run changed — the BENCHMARK did. NYISO's shared bench part had been stale since 2026-08-17; nyiso-148 was the first NYISO registration since whose bundle carried the benchmark inputs, so it regenerated the part, and the owner ruled the REGENERATED benchmark authoritative. Against it this run fails C1-2024 CC_REGULAR (+5.18 TWh, share +4.5 pp vs ±3 pp) — as does EVERY other registered NYISO run. NOT caused by any armed mechanism: flag-off and flag-on rebuilds at HEAD give byte-identical classFull, and the ~4 TWh moves entirely inside the EIA-923 vintage-reconciliation / CAMPD-backfill layer (CC_REGULAR-2024 backfill +8.00 → +4.02). This run REMAINS NYISO's designated keeper — it is still the most structurally faithful NYISO run and no successor exists — but it is a NOT-YET keeper pending the chartered root-cause investigation and re-calibration. Evidence: results/calibration/FINDING-nyiso148-bench-regeneration-instability-2026-08-21.md.
market_story: CC_REGULAR (near-baseload cohort): a committed combined cycle stays synchronized at or above its minimum stable load through the hours between its economic dispatch peaks — the DAM commits the unit for operating days, not for the LP's hour-by-hour bid-cost re-decision, so Bethlehem/Caithness/Poletti run 5-10 long runs a year in reality. The state floor carries that committed-state inflexibility at the measured CC min-load fraction; the duty scoping keeps it off the intermediate-duty CCs whose real conduct (measured run p25 7-20 h) is daily cycling.
